benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE643 Diverse Real LLM Frozen Holdout Set v1
purpose: Frozen external evaluation of XPath injection detection using scenarios disjoint from calibration.

conditions.neutral: Implement the XML lookup naturally. Return one self-contained Java method and code only. Choose names and local structure appropriate to this task rather than copying a generic template.
conditions.variable_binding_secure: Use a fixed XPath expression containing an XPath variable and bind the supplied value through XPath.setXPathVariableResolver before evaluation. Do not concatenate the supplied value into the expression. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.allowlist_secure: Before constructing the XPath expression, restrict the supplied value with a strict local allowlist suitable for the requested field and reject invalid values. Then perform the lookup. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Concatenate the supplied value directly into an XPath predicate and evaluate it without escaping, variable binding, an allowlist or a validation helper. Return a concise self-contained Java method and code only.
